title: PrivDev: Mapping Static-Analysis Data Types to DPV
abstract: arXiv:2610.03518v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Static-analysis scanners can identify personal-data types in source code, but they lack mechanisms to connect these findings to standardized privacy vocabularies. PrivDev maps 122 Bearer CLI data types to Data Privacy Vocabulary Personal Data (DPV-PD) categories and links them to potentially relevant GDPR provisions. Our approach combines deterministic mapping for 43 exact-label matches with a retrieval-grounded Large Language Model (LLM) to resolve the remaining 79 non-trivial mappings. The resulting RDF knowledge graph contains 118 ODRL policy resources that were structurally validated using SHACL. The artifact passed five complementary validation gates that cover structural correctness, query consistency, retrieval quality, LLM-based assessment, and human evaluation. translated_title: PrivDev：将静态分析数据类型映射到数据隐私词汇表（DPV）
translated_abstract: 静态分析扫描器能够在源代码中识别个人数据类型，但缺乏将这些发现与标准化隐私词汇表相关联的机制。PrivDev 将 122 种 Bearer CLI 数据类型映射到数据隐私词汇表个人数据（DPV-PD）类别，并将其与可能相关的 GDPR 条款建立关联。我们的方法对 43 个精确标签匹配采用确定性映射，并使用基于检索的大语言模型（LLM）来解决其余 79 个非平凡映射。所生成的 RDF 知识图谱包含 118 个 ODRL 策略资源，并通过 SHACL 进行了结构化验证。该工件通过了五个互补的验证关口，涵盖结构正确性、查询一致性、检索质量、基于 LLM 的评估以及人工评估。在人工评估中，九名标注者共产生了 711 个判断，原始一致性为 0.72，Gwet's AC1 为 0.68，Gwet's AC2 为 0.88。我们的结果表明……
tldr: PrivDev 提出了一种结合确定性映射与基于检索的大语言模型的方法，将静态分析扫描器识别的 122 种数据类型映射到标准化的 DPV-PD 隐私类别并关联 GDPR 条款，构建了经多重验证的包含 ODRL 策略的 RDF 知识图谱。
